articles.title: Starlink's Monthly Subscription Fee Decreases by 44 Dollars Since Beta Launch
articles.summary: SpaceX has reduced its monthly subscription fee from $99 to $55 in select areas for US customers.
articles.content: Starlink's public beta launched in October 2020 with a monthly subscription fee of $99 and an upfront cost of $499 for the equipment. This meant customers paid nearly $600 to get started with the satellite internet service. In contrast, today SpaceX offers its US customers a more affordable option starting at just $55 per month, with no upfront equipment cost in select areas. The monthly savings for new customers amounts to $44 less than what early adopters paid six years ago. This translates to an annual saving of $528 on the subscription alone. The shift from owning equipment to renting it has also changed the way customers pay for Starlink's satellite internet service. Those who signed up during the beta phase had to purchase their own equipment, which came with a hefty price tag. However, they were also warned about potential outages, making the initial investment seem more substantial. Starlink now offers three separate residential tiers at different network speeds and price plans. The company has increased its rates in 2026, but the entry-level rate remains lower than it was back in 2020. With discounts and fluctuating rates based on local demand, two customers could end up paying vastly different bills for the same service. The initial offering of Starlink's public beta was aptly named "Better Than Nothing Beta", reflecting its transparent and accurate expectations for users. Download speeds of 50 to 150 Mbps and latency of 20 to 40ms were the promised benchmarks, although occasional periods of zero connectivity were also on the table. This was in line with what customers could reasonably expect from the service's early stages. The hardware kit provided as part of the initial package included a circular satellite dish, a mounting tripod, and a Wi-Fi router, all for a flat price of $499. The first month's subscription payment of $99 added to this total, making the initial outlay $598 before accounting for shipping and taxes. For those accustomed to reliable broadband connections, the costs associated with Starlink may have seemed steep, but they could still represent an acceptable trade-off for individuals struggling with slow DSL or unreliable cellular service. The monthly subscription rate increased in March 2022, rising to $110 for existing users, while new customers were initially charged a higher price of $599 for the hardware kit. The satellite internet service has undergone significant pricing adjustments since its launch. In addition to the three primary residential plans, Starlink now offers various options for subscribers to access high-speed internet. These plans include Residential 100 Mbps for $55 per month, Residential 200 Mbps for $85, and Residential Max at $130. Each of these plans comes with unlimited data, but the first two are subject to speed limits. However, the Residential Max plan boasts higher network priority and claims speeds of 400 Mbps or more in suitable conditions. This plan is likely to be a popular choice for those who require faster internet speeds. In May 2026, SpaceX increased prices across all three plans by $5, $5, and $10 respectively. This price hike was followed by additional location-based changes announced in October 2026, which affected some Residential Max customers' bills. While some were informed that their bills would rise to $156 per month, others were told they would decrease. Starlink is also offering equipment rentals in several regions, providing an alternative to purchasing the dish upfront. Subscribers who opt for this option are charged a $10 monthly rental fee, which was reportedly waived for new orders in July 2026. It's worth noting that Starlink still owns the rented hardware and subscribers must return it within 30 days of canceling their plan or pay its retail price. A promotion running through November 30, 2026, offered new subscribers up to 50 percent off on their plans. However, this discount only applies as long as the subscription remains active. Starlink's pricing adjustments and promotions demonstrate the company's efforts to make high-speed internet more accessible and affordable for its customers. Availability seems to be Starlink's greatest selling point, despite its prices often surpassing those of traditional internet services like cable and fiber. In fact, for a one-time fee of $55, users can access 100GB of high-speed internet through the company's portable Roam service. However, it's worth noting that once this data limit is reached, speeds significantly decrease. For customers who prefer to avoid these speed reductions altogether, Starlink offers an alternative plan called Roam Unlimited, which costs a flat $175 per month with no data cap limitations whatsoever. articles.title: Dallas Cowboys Hand Steelers Loss in Week 11
articles.summary: The Dallas Cowboys' high-powered offense put on a show in Week 11, scoring at will against the Tennessee Titans and handing the Steelers a loss.
articles.content: The Dallas Cowboys' high-powered offense put on a show in Week 11, scoring at will against the Tennessee Titans and handing the Steelers a loss. The win was crucial for the Cowboys, who needed it to stay in contention in the NFC East. A season that had been slipping away from them would have become even more dire with a defeat to a one-win team. But thanks to their explosive offense, they were able to avoid disaster by a wide margin and pick up their third win in five games. Behind Dak Prescott's nearly flawless performance, CeeDee Lamb, George Pickens, Javonte Williams, and the rest of the offense made it impossible for the Titans to keep up. The Cowboys' 51-30 drubbing of the Titans was a stark contrast to their defense's struggles earlier in the season. The Pittsburgh Steelers, on the other hand, suffered a disappointing loss against an opponent they were expected to beat easily. Their inability to live up to expectations has become a recurring theme this season. Despite Christian Parker's demotion from play-caller, the Cowboys' defense still struggled to contain the Titans' offense. They surrendered 30 points and allowed Carnell Tate to score one of the most unusual touchdowns of the year. The Steelers' loss was particularly damaging because they were expected to dominate their opponent. Instead, they found themselves on the wrong end of a lopsided score, which will only add to their woes. The Cowboys' win was a testament to their ability to put points on the board, even when their defense is struggling. It's a skill that has served them well this season and will be crucial in the weeks ahead. For now, the Cowboys can breathe a sigh of relief after avoiding disaster against a one-win team. But with their season still hanging in the balance, they'll need to keep up this level of performance if they want to stay alive in the NFC East race. The Dallas Cowboys' offense was a well-oiled machine on Sunday, scoring touchdowns on each of their first six drives and ultimately finding the end zone seven times in total. This impressive display marked a franchise record for consecutive possessions ending in a touchdown to start a game. The team's success can be attributed not only to the Titans' struggling defense but also to the star power of their own offense. CeeDee Lamb was a key contributor to this historic performance, becoming the first receiver in Cowboys history to achieve six consecutive 1,000-yard seasons. His teammate, Jameson Pickens, also crossed the 100-yard mark in the blowout victory. The duo's impressive performances were a major factor in the team's success. The Pittsburgh Steelers suffered a disappointing loss on Sunday, falling to the Philadelphia Eagles by a margin of just three points. This setback marked the 12th consecutive defeat for the Steelers against their in-state rivals, dating back to 1965. Despite being members of different conferences, the two teams only meet every few years, making this losing streak all the more notable. The Steelers had hoped that Sunday's matchup would be a turning point for their season, helping them bounce back from last week's lackluster performance against the Cincinnati Bengals. Instead, they found themselves on the wrong end of a close game, with the Eagles emerging victorious despite being led by quarterback Joe Milton. While it is still early in the season, this loss will undoubtedly be remembered as one that could have made a significant difference. The Steelers' struggles were not limited to their inability to beat the Eagles. If they fail to secure a playoff berth at the end of the season, they may look back on Sunday's game as one they should have won. This is not to say that the loss was devastating, but rather that it will likely be remembered as a missed opportunity. The Carolina Panthers and Baltimore Ravens engaged in an exhilarating contest on Sunday, with seven lead changes throughout the game. The second quarter saw four of these lead changes, while the final period featured two more. In the end, the Panthers emerged victorious, thanks to a 37-yard field goal from Ryan Fitzgerald that put them ahead by two points with just over a minute remaining. The Ravens had pushed the Panthers' defense to its limits throughout the game, but ultimately came up just short of securing a win. The contest was one of the most entertaining and chaotic of the season, with both teams displaying impressive skill and determination. Despite the Panthers' narrow victory, they remain leaders in their division, having secured 35 points against a tough opponent. Their ability to adapt and respond to the Ravens' aggressive playmaking will undoubtedly be crucial as they move forward in the season. The Steelers' loss on Sunday was just one of several notable outcomes from Week 11's games. As the teams continue to vie for position in their respective divisions, fans can expect more thrilling matchups and unpredictable results in the weeks to come. The Panthers have taken advantage of their division's misfortunes to widen their lead at the top. With three other teams in the division sitting on 3-7 records, Carolina now stands two games clear and is firmly establishing itself as a force to be reckoned with. Carolina's win over the Ravens was no cakewalk, despite the latter's struggles all season. The Panthers' victory has improved their record to .500 and put them in a stronger position than ever before. Trevor Lawrence had a day to forget for the Jaguars against the Giants. Despite throwing for 301 yards, he struggled under pressure and made several costly errors, including two interceptions and three sacks. The Jacksonville Jaguars are not accustomed to being on the wrong end of game scripts this season. However, they found themselves in that position twice recently, with Lawrence struggling to make a positive impact. Lawrence's inability to lead his team to a comeback proved decisive against the Giants. Despite taking until the fourth quarter to score a touchdown, it was too late for the Jaguars to mount a successful challenge. The loss has put the Jaguars behind pace in their bid for the No. 1 seed in the AFC. With Lawrence struggling to replicate his typical form, the team will need to regroup and find a way to overcome its current difficulties if they are to stay on track. Travis Kelce's impressive performance on Sunday added another chapter to his storied career as a Kansas City Chiefs tight end. The veteran player scored two touchdowns in the team's 34-7 rout of the Arizona Cardinals, marking a significant milestone for him. Kelce's achievements did not stop there. He also ended a prolonged drought by hauling in multiple scoring passes for the first time in 47 games, moving him up a spot on the NFL tight end career touchdown list. The Kansas City Chiefs' Arrowhead Stadium has been home to some remarkable feats, and Travis Kelce is no exception. On Sunday, he became the fourth player in franchise history to play 100 regular-season games at this iconic venue. Kelce's historic day was marked by a series of impressive achievements that cement his status as one of the league's top tight ends. His performance will undoubtedly be remembered for years to come as part of his illustrious career with the Kansas City Chiefs. In other news, DK Metcalf's antics on Sunday did little to impress fans or coaches alike. The Steelers wide receiver made an inexcusable decision when he poked Cooper DeJean in the eye during a heated exchange in the third quarter. This incident drew an unsportsmanlike conduct penalty and prompted Metcalf's ejection from the game, adding insult to injury for a player who was already struggling on the field. He caught just one pass for 2 yards across four targets, failing to back up his trash talk with any notable performance. The Steelers' loss to the Eagles in Week 10 had already been a tough pill to swallow, and Metcalf's actions did nothing to salvage the team's chances of turning their season around. His history of run-ins with opponents and fans continues to raise questions about his ability to maintain composure under pressure. The Chicago Bears' general manager Ryan Poles has made several key transactions that have significantly impacted the team's current standing as a contender for the NFC's top seed. While the recent trade of Darnell Simmons is particularly notable, it's just one example of Poles' shrewd decision-making throughout the season. Poles' moves have been instrumental in shaping the Bears into a formidable force in the NFC. articles.title: Economic Hardships Did Not Deter Thanksgiving Celebrations During The Great Depression
articles.summary: Families found ways to make the holiday special despite their circumstances during the 1930s economic downturn.
articles.content: In times of economic hardship, it's natural to question the value of celebrations like Thanksgiving. When basic needs are unmet, a lavish feast can seem like an extravagance. However, having something to look forward to and share with loved ones is crucial for morale during difficult periods. The Great Depression brought unparalleled economic devastation in the 1930s, making it impossible for many Americans to afford even basic necessities, let alone a traditional Thanksgiving meal. Yet, families found ways to make the holiday special despite their circumstances. They demonstrated remarkable resourcefulness and creativity in preparing meals with limited ingredients. The typical Thanksgiving spread was far from what we know today during this period. Many people had to rely on government assistance programs or charitable organizations for food, and even then, the options were severely limited. However, families made do with what they had, often turning to traditional recipes that required minimal ingredients and effort. As one might expect, Thanksgiving dinner was a stark departure from its modern counterpart during the Great Depression. People used their skills and imagination to create simple yet meaningful meals that brought them closer together. Despite the hardships, these gatherings played a vital role in boosting spirits and providing hope for a brighter future. The Great Depression cast a long shadow over American lives, and Thanksgiving was no exception. Families struggled to make ends meet, and traditional holiday meals were often out of reach. Yet, even in the face of hardship, people found ways to adapt and celebrate. In place of the usual turkey, many families resorted to alternative proteins. Meat was scarce and expensive, so they made do with whatever they could afford. For some, this meant relying on soup kitchens or charities that provided Thanksgiving meals. The menu may have been humble, but it showed a remarkable resourcefulness in the face of adversity. People got creative with leftovers and scraps, turning old hen into a satisfying main course. Mock duck was another popular substitute, made by wrapping flank steak around stuffing and roasting it to perfection. This makeshift dish was surprisingly convincing, evoking the luxury of a high-end meal without breaking the bank. It's a testament to the ingenuity of Depression-era cooks who managed to turn scraps into something special. Porcupine meatballs were another clever invention, made by sticking rice into ground beef to make it go further. Rice was used as a filler in many dishes during this period, and its versatility proved invaluable. By incorporating it into porcupine meatballs, families could stretch their food budget and make a meal feel more substantial. It's a small but significant detail that speaks to the resilience of those who lived through these difficult times. In a bid to make meals more filling, cooks also experimented with cooking techniques. Old chickens, no longer able to lay eggs, were used as a last resort, but only if cooked carefully to avoid tough meat. In an effort to stretch their Thanksgiving meals during the Great Depression, Americans turned to creative substitutions for traditional ingredients. Porcupine meatballs were one such invention, achieved by mixing ground beef with rice to make it more filling. Flank steak wrapped around stuffing and roasted was another clever imitation of a fancy dish. This "mock duck" was a cost-effective way to create the illusion of a luxurious meal, making it feel more like a special occasion. The use of leftover meat in this manner also helped reduce food waste. Stale bread was a staple ingredient for many dishes during this time, and stuffing was one that benefited greatly from its availability. People would add various ingredients they had on hand to their stuffing, including apples, raisins, or chestnuts foraged from their surroundings. Dandelion salads were another popular side dish, as the plants were easily gathered from home gardens or yards. This resourcefulness helped families make the most of what little food they had available to them. In the midst of economic hardship, Depression-era families still found ways to celebrate Thanksgiving with a traditional meal. Canned vegetables played a crucial role in these gatherings, as they were not only affordable but also readily available. Recipes from radio shows like Aunt Sammy's Homemaker's Half Hour helped families liven up their canned food offerings, making dishes such as creamed pearl onions and candied sweet potatoes. These recipes not only added flavor to the meal but also provided a sense of normalcy in uncertain times. The fact that potatoes were inexpensive made mashed potatoes a staple at many Thanksgiving tables. This was especially important given the limited availability of other ingredients, which were often out of reach for those struggling financially. Dessert, an essential part of any Thanksgiving celebration, presented a unique challenge during this period. With sugar and other baking essentials being luxury items, pumpkin pie became a rare treat. Only those who could afford to purchase canned pumpkin purée or obtain an actual pumpkin from their garden were able to make this traditional dessert. The scarcity of ingredients forced families to get creative with sweet treats. Instead of relying on traditional recipes, they used canned foods as substitutes, making do with what little they had available. This resourcefulness not only helped families save money but also ensured that everyone could enjoy a festive meal together. As families sat down to their Thanksgiving feast, they were reminded that even in times of hardship, there was still much to be thankful for. The simple yet satisfying meals they shared brought people closer together and provided a sense of community during a difficult period. During the Great Depression, American families turned to resourceful uses for everyday ingredients to create satisfying meals on Thanksgiving. Sweetened condensed milk became a staple in many households, allowing them to make a rich sugar cream pie as a dessert option. The versatility of tomato soup was also put to use in an unconventional way: it was used as a main ingredient in making a cake. Despite sounding unappetizing to modern palates, the resulting tomato soup cake was surprisingly sweet and dense, thanks to its simple ingredients. When all else failed, families could rely on B & M Brown Bread, a canned product that offered a sweet and cake-like treat during difficult times. articles.content: A new free utility suite for macOS has been gaining popularity among users looking to customize their desktop experience. The app, known as Vorssaint, offers a range of tools that aim to improve productivity and control over how users interact with their Macs. Vorssaint is an open-source application hosted on GitHub, where it has garnered significant attention from the developer community. With over 33,000 stars and 230 contributors, the project's popularity suggests that there is a clear need for a more comprehensive utility suite on macOS. One of the key pain points that Vorssaint seeks to address is the limited window-tiling options available natively on macOS. The app offers a range of tiling features, including edge snapping and customizable shortcuts, allowing users to arrange their application windows in a more intuitive way. The app's feature set also includes a toggle for clamshell mode, which enables MacBooks to continue running even with their lids closed. This can be particularly useful for users who need to keep working on their laptops without being distracted by the screen or keyboard. The Vorssaint application suite has been designed to streamline daily workflows by providing a range of handy tools that can replace multiple utility apps on macOS. One such tool is its screenshot utility, which offers scrolling screenshots that allow users to capture content extending beyond what's visible on the screen. With Vorssaint, users can also edit captured screenshots using the app's built-in image editing tool. Additionally, the media tool within Vorssaint supports video compression, image conversion, and text extraction from images. Furthermore, its system monitoring tool provides valuable information on thermals, memory usage, and network speed, extending beyond what Apple's Activity Monitor offers. Vorssaint's utility stack is packed with a graphical interface for Homebrew, which can be accessed through the app's command bar. The command bar serves as a powerful search function that allows users to quickly find apps, files, and even perform mathematical calculations or unit conversions by simply searching for them. The suite also includes a URL cleaner, adding another useful feature to Vorssaint's already impressive list of tools. Its robust utility stack undoubtedly makes it a promising productivity suite for power users who require such features. However, some of the more powerful tools within Vorssaint may request sensitive macOS permissions, including Accessibility, Screen Recording, Full Disk Access, and Automation. Users should be aware that granting these permissions is necessary to allow Vorssaint to perform certain functions, but they must also understand what it means to grant system-level permissions to third-party applications. Vorssaint's modular design allows for a tailored approach to installing modules, enabling users to pick and choose what suits their needs best. This selective installation method means that individuals can opt for specific features without having to grant unnecessary permissions. For instance, someone looking to streamline window management can install just the Window layout module, thereby avoiding sensitive permissions. Users seeking an open-source solution will appreciate Vorssaint's approach, which emphasizes a local-first and account-free experience. The app does not require users to subscribe to any service or share usage analytics with the developer, allowing for a more private experience. However, it is essential to note that an application's open-source nature does not guarantee its security. Vorssaint's emphasis on user control and transparency makes it an attractive option for those who value their digital sovereignty. By providing users with the flexibility to choose which modules to install and what permissions to grant, Vorssaint strikes a balance between functionality and security. articles.title: Audio Equipment Trends Shift Towards Headphone DAC/Amp Combos and Separate Stacks
articles.summary: Users are opting for either headphone DAC/amp combos or separate stacks to enhance their listening experience, with both options delivering high-quality sound.
articles.content: A new trend in audio equipment has emerged, where users are opting for either a headphone DAC/amp combo or a separate stack to enhance their listening experience. The good news is that both options can deliver high-quality sound, but it ultimately depends on the user's specific needs and preferences. Not all headphones require an external amplifier, as some computers and laptops have built-in audio capabilities that can handle low- to high-impedance headphones with ease. For instance, MacBooks from 2021 onwards support a range of headphones, delivering up to 3 volts RMS through their headphone jacks when used with compatible headphones. However, if the computer or laptop's headphone jack is not capable of delivering clean audio at a comfortable volume, then investing in external equipment may be necessary. This could include a DAC (digital-to-analog converter) and amp that work together to enhance sound quality. The key difference between a DAC/amp combo and a separate stack lies in their design and functionality. A single unit can provide both digital signal conversion and amplification, while the latter option involves using two distinct devices for each task. A DAC/amp combo offers several advantages over separate units, particularly for listeners seeking to improve their computer's audio without sacrificing space or convenience. This setup allows for a single unit that handles both digital signal conversion and amplification, thereby reducing clutter and the need for multiple power adapters. In terms of value, DAC/amps can provide a more cost-effective solution compared to purchasing separate devices. For instance, Schiit's Magni 6 is available with an optional internal USB DAC for $169. On the other hand, buying the unit without the DAC allows for pairing with an external DAC like the Modi 5 for $149, which totals over $250 and still requires an additional interconnect cable. The assumption that a standalone DAC must offer superior sound quality to justify its separate existence is not necessarily true. The Modi 5, while boasting optical and coaxial inputs, does not automatically guarantee better performance than a well-designed DAC/amp combo. A notable example of a high-end DAC/amp combo is the JDS Labs Element IV, which delivers up to 3.2 watts per channel into 32 ohms and features automatic gain switching, EQ, and preamp outputs for powered speakers. This level of performance often obviates the need for a dedicated amplifier, making it suitable for many demanding headphones. The main drawback of opting for a DAC/amp combo is that users are locked into the single unit and cannot upgrade individual components piecemeal if desired. When it comes to upgrading your home audio setup, one option is to go for a headphone DAC/amp combo or build a stack of separate components. While combos offer convenience and a compact design, separates can provide more flexibility and customization options. A dedicated amplifier can be particularly beneficial for certain types of headphones that require more power to sound their best. For example, high-impedance headphones often demand significant amplification to produce clear and detailed sound, while planar magnetic models may benefit from low impedance and sensitivity. In some cases, a standalone amp is the better choice due to its ability to provide precise control over power output. The HiFiMAN Susvara Unveiled, for instance, has specific requirements that make it well-suited to a dedicated amplifier. However, too much power can also be detrimental, introducing audible hiss into sensitive headphones. When choosing between a combo and a stack, consider the specific needs of your headphones. Check their power requirements and look for an amplifier with good noise performance to avoid unwanted hiss or distortion. A separate amplifier can offer additional features and flexibility that may not be available in a DAC/amp combo. These can include extra analog inputs, more gain settings, or even balanced headphone connectors, all potentially valuable perks for audiophiles who like to customize their setup. Ultimately, the decision between a headphone DAC/amp combo and a separate stack comes down to individual preferences and needs. While combos offer convenience, separates provide the freedom to upgrade and customize your home audio setup in more ways. The Dow Jones industrial average is poised for a strong start to the week, with futures surging nearly 700 points, or 1.41%. This early morning boost has given Wall Street cause for optimism about the coming year. The S&P 500 and Nasdaq are also seeing significant gains, with futures up by 2.1% and 2.89%, respectively. These numbers indicate a significant rebound from the correction that saw all three major indices plummet last week. The correction was sparked by concerns over the AI boom's sustainability. Concerns about the AI industry have been driving the market's downturn in recent weeks, as investors worry that the sector may be due for a bust. Tech shares have led the selloff, with many experts pointing to the Nvidia spy scandal and China's backdoor access to high-end U.S. chips as major contributors. The Nvidia scandal has raised questions about the company's "circular financing deals, which some fear may unravel, leaving companies in its ecosystem without capital for new data centers or AI chips. This uncertainty has added fuel to the fire of market anxiety. As a result, the federal government is cracking down on loopholes in export restrictions to prevent China from gaining access to sensitive technology. Meanwhile, President Trump has vowed to stop U.S. companies from building data centers abroad, further limiting their ability to expand into new markets. The economic impact of the recent stock market correction continues to be felt, according to Mark Zandi, Chief Economist at Moody's Analytics. He has warned that the selloff could have a lasting effect on consumer spending through the wealth effect, which plays a significant role in determining GDP growth. Zandi estimates that for every dollar change in net worth, consumer spending increases or decreases by about 2 cents over a period of approximately one year. If stock prices remain stagnant, this would translate to a loss of almost 0.3 percentage points from real GDP growth in the coming year, after initially contributing 0.7 percentage points to growth. Zandi also cautioned that investors may be mistaken in assuming AI stocks will continue to rebound quickly as they have done before, stating We've seen AI stocks selloff before, only for them to rebound quickly. He warned that if this trend continues, the economy would no longer rely on AI as its primary driver of growth. The upcoming shortened week could bring some relief to Wall Street, although it is still several weeks away from the traditional Santa Claus rally" that typically occurs at the end of the year. Markets will observe a brief respite from trading activity this week, as they are closed for Thanksgiving on Thursday and open for only half a day on Friday. This reduction in trading hours may amplify any stock rebounds that occur during this period. Thin volumes could thus contribute to the momentum of rising stocks. Wall Street analysts remain cautiously optimistic about 2027's prospects despite the current market correction. Morgan Stanley and Goldman Sachs are predicting a year-end S&P 500 index value of 8,700. In contrast, UBS Global Wealth Management and Wells Fargo have forecasted a slightly lower target of 8,200 for next year. Steve Chiavarone, chief investment officer for equities at Federated Hermes, has expressed his confidence in the market's potential by setting an ambitious year-end goal of 10,000. This represents a significant surge of nearly 45% from current levels. By downplaying concerns over the midterm elections' impact on AI infrastructure growth, Chiavarone believes that even a slight pullback could be beneficial for the industry's long-term sustainability. articles.title: Reliance on technology is eroding trust in one another and ability to tell what is even real, expert warns
articles.summary: The increasing reliance on technology is eroding trust in one another and making it harder to distinguish what's real from what's fabricated.
articles.content: A growing concern among experts is that our increasing reliance on technology is eroding trust in one another and making it harder to distinguish what's real from what's fabricated. This warning comes from Mateusz Łabuz, author of the book "The End of Reality, which explores the consequences of our dependence on AI-generated content. According to Łabuz, the danger posed by generative AI is not just a matter of some catastrophic algorithmic failure, but rather a gradual decline in our ability to discern fact from fiction. The proliferation of synthetic content has added yet another layer of complexity to an already uncertain world, where trust in authorities, governments, and media institutions is waning. This has created a perfect storm of confusion and uncertainty, with AI-generated information further muddying the waters. As Łabuz notes, Everything we see, hear or read can now be the work of AI, raising fundamental questions about the nature of reality. The consequences of this erosion of trust are far-reaching, according to Łabuz, who argues that it is not just our perception of reality that is at stake. The very fabric of our society is being affected, as people become increasingly desensitized to the distinction between fact and fiction. As he warns, Every single day, we are collectively tested on our perception, and collectively fail it. This failure has serious implications for our individual and collective well-being. For most of human history, individuals had control over how reality was presented and recorded, even if this was imperfect. However, with the advent of AI-generated content, this dynamic is shifting, and the consequences are far from clear. As Łabuz's book highlights, the impact of generative AI on our ability to distinguish fact from fiction is a pressing concern that requires immediate attention. The shift towards a technology-driven society has been gradual, but its impact on trust and reality is undeniable. Traditional gatekeepers like governments, churches, and media institutions once held significant control over the information that reached the public. They acted as filters, ensuring some level of quality control, even if they could be wrong or abusive in their decision-making. However, with the rise of social media and AI-driven recommendation systems, this traditional mechanism of control has been largely dismantled. Instead, society now forms its beliefs based on real-time content created by millions of users, often without any checks or balances in place. As algorithms take on a gatekeeping role, deciding what information is prioritized and what is relegated to the digital shadows, personalization has morphed into something more insidious, a form of curated manipulation. The incentives driving technology systems have been fundamentally misaligned with truth from their inception. Emotion, not information, became the fuel," he explains, highlighting how algorithms now prioritize sensational content that sparks strong emotions over factual accuracy. This approach has led to a glut of emotionally charged, scandalous, and often false material being fed to users as a way to capture their attention and monetize every second of their time. The system's reward structure has created a perverse incentive for creators to produce cheap, mass-produced content that is more likely to go viral than be factually accurate. This includes the proliferation of sexualized imagery, xenophobic clickbait, and nonsensical characters designed to elicit a reaction rather than educate or inform. Łabuz draws on philosopher Jean Baudrillard's concept of hyperreality to describe how these simulations have become indistinguishable from reality itself. Generative AI has turned this philosophical idea into a daily experience, where synthetic feelings and emotions are treated as genuine because they are reproduced with extraordinary plausibility. The line between what's real and what's not is increasingly blurred as synthetic worlds created by algorithms and human interactions gain prominence over traditional human-made realities. This shift has profound implications for our understanding of truth, according to Łabuz. He envisions a future where the digital remnants of our current era are excavated by archaeologists, revealing a pivotal moment when technology began to supplant human-created information. Within a decade, this artificial world had eclipsed its human counterpart, casting doubt on what's genuine and what's fabricated. The consequences of this phenomenon are far-reaching, Łabuz warns. As tools empowering anyone to craft their own reality become more prevalent, collective agreement on the truth becomes increasingly elusive. This vulnerability can be exploited by malicious actors seeking to manipulate public opinion, undermine institutions, and dismantle trust in democracy. These concerns are not unfounded, as technology has already enabled the creation of nonconsensual intimate materials, exploitation of likeness for fraud or extortion, and social destabilization through disinformation. The very fabric of our society is at risk of being torn apart by the unchecked use of these tools. Despite the gravity of this situation, Łabuz remains hopeful that humanity's inherent nature will drive us to uphold rigorous scientific inquiry and critical thinking. He believes that by recognizing when to set aside technology's influence, we can reclaim control over our reality and preserve the integrity of truth. Preserving our capacity for independent thought and personal responsibility is crucial in today's technology-driven world. This means recognizing when to set aside the influence of algorithms and taking ownership of our decisions and actions. By doing so, we can reclaim control over our reality and preserve the integrity of truth. It's not about rejecting technological progress entirely or retreating into an analog existence, but rather about striking a balance between technology and human agency. articles.content: A recent realization has led me to reflect on a significant change in my life. It started when I was researching the differences between sea salt and rock salt, a topic that may seem unrelated but ultimately sparked a new perspective. As I scrolled through old photos of nights out with friends, one particular image caught my eye - it showed them laughing and carefree in an east London restaurant's smoking area. They looked like they were having the time of their lives, and yet I felt... ambivalent. In that moment, I couldn't help but think about how far I've come from my wild days. Gone are the times when I'd go out with friends every night, dressing to impress in thrifted grandad shirts and skinny jeans, just like Kate Moss for Topshop was all the rage back then. Those nights were marked by spontaneity and a disregard for tomorrow's consequences. We'd drink, laugh, and toast to nothing, smashing our empty glasses down without a care in the world. My friends would often joke about my stamina - I could keep up with them well into the night, even on a weeknight. I recall walking home from bars at 3 pm, drenched in glitter and feeling like I was invincible. But now, I realize that all that chaos was not just a phase of my life, but an integral part of my identity - or so I thought. As I reflect on my past, I realize that my life was a whirlwind of chaos and spontaneity. Sleep was not a priority, and meals were often an afterthought. My focus was on living in the moment, and I didn't worry about the consequences of my actions. I had few responsibilities and was still trying to figure out who I was and where I fit in the world. As a result, I developed a carefree attitude, prioritizing excitement over stability. A lack of self-preservation was mistaken for spontaneity, and disorganization was seen as a sign of a vibrant social life. The concept of being well-organized or structured seemed dull and unappealing to me. I thought that those who had their lives together were missing out on the thrill of living. The idea of having everything planned out and under control was seen as stifling, rather than liberating. I wasn't alone in my views; many people shared a similar attitude towards life. We romanticized being a bit of a disaster, embracing the chaos and unpredictability that came with it. This carefree attitude was partly influenced by the music scene of the time, which celebrated individuality and nonconformity. But as I look back, I realize that this phase of my life was not just a passing phase, but an integral part of my identity - or so I thought. The contrast between my past and present is striking, and it's clear that I've undergone a significant transformation in recent years. As I've grown older, my tastes have shifted towards a more understated approach to life. Gone are the days of indulging in excess and extravagance; now, I find myself drawn to simplicity and functionality. Keeping things in order has become a source of pleasure for me - it's almost therapeutic. From maintaining a tidy living space to ensuring that all my belongings are in working condition, I've developed a sense of satisfaction from these small tasks. Of course, there's still room for the occasional indulgence - a night out with friends or a visit to a trendy bar can be enjoyable. However, even these experiences have become more subdued; I find myself leaving as soon as my duties are fulfilled, content in the knowledge that I've done what needed doing. Fatherhood has played a significant role in this transformation, forcing me to reevaluate my priorities and values. With another person relying on me, I've come to realize that treating myself like an afterthought isn't just impractical - it's also unglamorous. I'm beginning to see that being alive doesn't have to be a constant state of panic or anxiety; instead, it can be a simple, straightforward experience. As the responsibilities of parenthood take hold, self-care becomes a fundamental aspect of daily life. This shift in perspective has allowed me to appreciate the simple joys of an uneventful day, free from the need for damage control and last-minute apologies. With a toddler's unpredictable nature bringing chaos into my world, I've learned to redirect my energy towards creating a sense of calm and order in our home. articles.content: President Donald Trump is set to host a private dinner for high-stakes investors in his struggling cryptocurrency project, $TRUMP, just days after it hit rock bottom in value. The event is scheduled to take place on Sunday night, as Democrats gear up to take control of Congress and scrutinize the president's business dealings. The $TRUMP coin, launched just before Trump's second inauguration in January 2025, has witnessed a sharp decline in value since its peak at $74 per coin. It now trades for less than one dollar. The Democratic senators leading the charge on congressional oversight have made it clear that the president's cryptocurrency ventures will be under intense scrutiny. In a letter sent to the White House last month, eight Democrats, including Sen., expressed concerns about the dinner and its potential impact on investors. The letter sent to the White House raised concerns about President Trump's monetization of his name and likeness, sparking calls for a thorough investigation into his financial dealings. The signatories expressed alarm at the potential impact on investors, who may have been misled by the president's involvement in cryptocurrencies tied to his family's businesses. Among those who signed the letter are high-ranking Democrats with expertise in finance and oversight, including Sen. and Sen., both of whom sit on key committees that scrutinize financial dealings. Their concerns echo a broader warning from Aaron Reitz, an attorney for the Southern District of Texas, who cautioned against pursuing investigations into Trump's associates. The president's net worth has grown significantly since he took office in 2025, with nearly $3 billion added to his fortune. A substantial portion of this increase, over $1 billion, is attributed to cryptocurrencies linked to his family's businesses, although many investors have suffered significant losses on their investments in these assets. Sunday's exclusive dinner for investors at the president's golf club outside Washington has drawn attention to the matter, with questions about the event being directed by the White House to Fight Fight Fight LLC, the company behind the meme coin. The exclusive dinner event for investors in Trump's meme coin has raised eyebrows, particularly since it was not publicly listed on the president's schedule for Sunday. This is a common practice for the president, who often holds private gatherings at his properties over weekends. The weekend soirees are usually off-the-record social events. Celebrity guests have been invited to attend this exclusive dinner, including business magnate Kevin O'Leary and former NBA player Tristan Thompson. Professional boxer Floyd Mayweather will also be in attendance. According to the event's website, VIP guests will receive Trump-themed goody bags, while the top four holders of at least 1 million $TRUMP coins are promised gold Trump watches. It is not the first time that the president has hosted a dinner for his meme coin investors; a similar event took place in 2025. The weekend's exclusive gathering will undoubtedly be scrutinized by those questioning the legitimacy of the $TRUMP coin and its connections to the White House. articles.content: Brandon Sardi, founder of San Francisco-based Poorboy Coffee, has taken an unconventional approach to marketing his business by giving away free coffee in a pay-what-you-want model. The idea is not just about attracting customers, but also about supporting other local entrepreneurs. Every dollar collected from the coffee shop's "Who Gives a Hand" series goes directly into another small business's pocket. Poorboy Coffee started out with pop-up events at wine bars, where Sardi would spend hours setting up and hoping to make enough sales to justify the effort. This model was not economically sustainable for the company. The business eventually shifted to private catering, which provided a more stable income stream for Poorboy Coffee. The event's slow start caught Sardi off guard, echoing memories from Poorboy Coffee's earlier pop-up ventures that failed to draw a crowd. Social media promotion and the promise of free drinks had been expected to bring in a large number of customers, but surprisingly, it didn't quite materialize as anticipated. Despite the initially slow pace, the customers who did arrive were generous with their contributions, with some paying more than they would have for a typical drink at Poorboy Coffee's pop-ups. A live tracker displaying the total amount collected helped to encourage people to contribute, and over three hours, the event managed to collect $957 in pay-it-forward contributions. The pay-it-forward model has shown promising results in New York City, where a second pop-up event collected about $500. While not as successful as the initial event, this amount still demonstrates the potential of the concept. To ensure that everyone involved benefits from the initiative, Sardi's staff voluntarily forwent payment for their time and effort, choosing instead to contribute to the pay-it-forward spirit. This selfless gesture allowed them to participate in the exchange without drawing attention away from its true purpose. In addition to the customer contributions, Sardi also invested an extra $500 of his own money into the event, bringing the total amount collected to over $1,000. This generous contribution enabled Poorboy to pass on a substantial sum to another local business, further fostering community growth and goodwill. Despite incurring real costs such as ingredients, transportation, and staff time, Sardi believes that the benefits of the pay-it-forward model outweigh these expenses. By hosting events like this, he hopes to create a positive impact on both his own business and the wider community. articles.title: GPU Cleaning Process Requires Preparation and Caution
articles.summary: Cleaning a PC's graphics processing unit (GPU) can help maintain performance and extend lifespan by removing accumulated dust every three to six months.
articles.content: Cleaning your PC's graphics processing unit (GPU) may seem daunting, but it's a relatively straightforward process that can help maintain its performance and extend its lifespan. Over time, dust accumulates on the GPU, which can impair its thermal efficiency, causing it to run at lower clock speeds and potentially shortening its lifespan. Given current GPU prices in 2026, replacing your card unnecessarily is not an attractive option. Regular cleaning can help mitigate this issue by removing accumulated dust every three to six months. To clean the GPU safely, it's essential to remove it from the case first. This ensures that any dust is eliminated entirely from the system and prevents the risk of re-depositing particles onto the card during the cleaning process. Before attempting to remove the GPU, power down your PC completely and then open the case to access its internal components. Depending on the design of your case, you might not need a screwdriver to access the interior; some configurations require only loosening thumbscrews for easy access. However, older cases may necessitate using a Phillips head screwdriver. To prepare for the process, consider investing in an anti-static wrist strap for added protection, although this is not a mandatory precaution. If you don't already own a screwdriver or bit kit, iFixit offers various DIY repair kits that can be useful for this task. To continue with the cleaning process, you'll need to remove any dust or debris from the air blower's nozzle before using it on your GPU. This is crucial to prevent any potential damage to the card or its components. Now that you have all the necessary tools and a clean workspace, lay the GPU flat on the table to ensure it doesn't move around while cleaning. Next, carefully position the air blower or can of compressed air about 6 inches away from the GPU's surface. Use short bursts of compressed air or a gentle stream from the air blower to remove any loose dust particles from the GPU's surface. Make sure not to spray the liquid directly onto the card as it may damage its components. Keep the nozzle moving constantly to avoid applying too much pressure on one spot. If your GPU requires a deeper clean, dampen a microfiber cloth with 90 percent isopropyl alcohol and gently wipe down the entire surface. Be cautious not to touch any of the electrical components or connectors with the cloth as it may cause damage. When handling a GPU, it's essential to exercise caution, especially when cleaning it. If you're not comfortable removing your graphics card, you can still follow these steps to clean it without taking it out of the PC. To clean the fans on your GPU, use one hand to immobilize them and then employ a duster or compressed air to dislodge any debris that may be accumulated. It's crucial to prevent the fans from spinning freely when using compressed air, as this can cause damage to their bearings and send electrical current back into the card's fan controller. If your GPU's protective casing and backplate are dusty, you can use a clean microfiber cloth dampened with isopropyl alcohol to gently wipe them down. Be careful not to let the cloth get caught on any solder joints during this process. When reassembling your PC, make sure to insert your GPU into the PCIe slot that corresponds to your motherboard's fastest connection speed. Typically, this will be the top-most slot on most motherboards. Additionally, when reconnecting the PCIe power cables, ensure they are properly seated. It's also a good opportunity to clean other components in your system while the GPU is out of its casing. Regular cleaning of your PC's GPU can significantly extend its lifespan. This is especially true if you reside in an environment prone to dust accumulation. When selecting a case for your computer, consider one that maintains slightly positive air pressure. This setup allows the system to draw in more air than it expels, promoting airflow through the dust filters and reducing the need for frequent cleanings. However, not all cases can accommodate this configuration. When evaluating the thermals of your GPU, use 60 degrees Celsius as the lower limit and 80 degrees Celsius as the upper limit. articles.title: Monitor Problems Can Be Caused by Loose Connections or Faulty Cables
articles.summary: A flickering screen on your monitor can be caused by various issues, including loose connections, faulty cables, outdated graphics drivers, and incorrect settings.
articles.content: Monitors are now more affordable than ever, but that doesn't mean they're immune to problems. If you've noticed your screen flickering when you turn it on, it's not just a minor annoyance - it could be a sign of something more serious. Gaming and work can take a toll on our computer peripherals, including monitors. One common issue is the display cable itself, which might be loose or damaged. This is often the case with modern HDMI or DisplayPort cables, but older VGA connections are also susceptible to problems. The good news is that troubleshooting your monitor is relatively straightforward. By checking the cables and connections, you may be able to identify the source of the issue. In many cases, simply reinserting the cables or replacing a damaged one can resolve the problem. A flickering screen can have various causes, ranging from loose connections to more complex hardware issues. One possible explanation is that your monitor's display cable has become dislodged or is faulty in some way. A faulty cable or port can cause a flickering monitor, but it's not the only possibility. Swapping out the display cable for a new one may resolve the issue if that's indeed the problem. If there are multiple ports on both the monitor and computer, try using a different port to rule out any issues with the current setup. However, if replacing the cable doesn't work, it's worth investigating other potential causes of the flickering screen. One option is to test whether the issue persists when connected to a different computer that you know works properly. This will help isolate the problem and determine if it's related to the computer or the monitor itself. Graphics drivers can also be a source of display problems, including flickering monitors. If your graphics drivers are outdated, updating them may resolve the issue. Conversely, updating drivers can sometimes cause new problems, so rolling back to a previous version may be necessary in some cases. It's essential to consider other factors that could be contributing to the problem. For instance, if the monitor is set to run at a specific refresh rate but your computer's settings don't match, this mismatch can cause display issues. To fix this, go to your computer's Settings and navigate to System on the left panel. In the Display section, look for Advanced display options, where you can adjust the refresh rate to match your monitor's capabilities. Make sure that your computer's settings are aligned with the requirements of your monitor to avoid any further problems. To troubleshoot this issue, it may be necessary to experiment with different combinations of cables and ports or try updating graphics drivers. By methodically ruling out potential causes, you can identify the root of the problem and take steps to resolve it. When a monitor flickers persistently after initial troubleshooting efforts have failed, it's likely that the issue lies deeper than a simple hardware or software problem. A consistent, almost stuttering pattern of flickering is often an ominous sign that the monitor is nearing a complete failure, and may be on the verge of shutting down completely. In some cases, the display may also experience sudden blackouts before returning to normal operation, providing further evidence that something is amiss with the monitor's internal workings. Other telltale signs of a malfunctioning monitor include faded or dim colors, as well as vertical lines that appear to be in motion across the screen. By examining these symptoms and comparing them to similar issues on a TV, it may be possible to diagnose the problem more effectively. Ultimately, if all other options have been exhausted without resolving the issue, it's probably time to consider replacing or repairing the monitor, with the cost of new OLED and 4K screens becoming increasingly affordable. He presents himself as a centrist, focusing on issues that could appeal to moderate conservatives. This approach helped him secure the Senate seat in a state often considered a battleground. Experts suggest that Ossoff's moderate stance may not be as effective in Democratic primaries, where voters tend to prioritize ideological purity over pragmatism.
